🚀 Get 10% Commissions on High-Quality Audio Products That Range From $39 - $2000+ 🎧

Introducing Edifier - a pioneer in cutting-edge audio technology and design, committed to providing exceptional sound experiences for music enthusiasts and audiophiles worldwide.

🌟 Brand Introduction:

Edifier specializes in premium sound systems, headphones, and speakers that cater to a wide range of customers - from casual listeners to audio professionals. Our innovative products have garnered numerous international design awards and worldwide acclaim.

 

🎵 Product Descriptions:

Our diverse product lineup includes:

1. Bookshelf Speakers - Sleek and powerful, perfect for home entertainment or professional use.

2. Bluetooth Speakers - Portable and versatile, delivering high-quality audio on-the-go.

3. Gaming Headsets - Immersive audio experiences for gamers, with superior comfort and durability.

4. Studio Monitors - Unmatched audio accuracy for professionals and audio enthusiasts.

5. Home Theater Systems - Transforming living rooms into cinematic experiences.

 

🏆 USP (Unique Selling Points):

1. Unparalleled Sound Quality - Industry-leading audio technology for an exceptional listening experience.

2. Stylish Design - A perfect blend of form and function, with a touch of elegance.

3. Wide Product Range - Catering to various audio needs and preferences.

4. Excellent Customer Support - Our team is dedicated to ensuring customer satisfaction.

💰 Commission Payment Terms:

We offer a competitive 10% commission on every sale made through your referral link. Payouts are made on a monthly basis through our affiliate platform.

 

🎁 Why Affiliates Should Promote Edifier (Benefits of Being Our Affiliate):

1. High-Quality Products - Showcase and promote premium audio products that resonate with your audience.

2. High Conversion Rates - Our exceptional products and strong brand reputation lead to higher conversions.

3. Generous Commissions - Earn a lucrative 10% commission on every sale.

4. Dedicated Support - Our affiliate team is always here to help you optimize your campaigns.

5. Exclusive Promotions - Access to special offers and promotional materials to boost your promotions.

 

👉🏼 **Product Samples Available!**

Join the Edifier affiliate program today and start earning with the best in audio technology! Sign up TODAY

Edifier USA Affiliate Program Terms & Conditions

Welcome to Edifier USA! Thanks for joining our Affiliate Program.

These terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we”, “us”) and an affiliate (“you”) who refers customers to purchase products or services from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, you agree to comply with these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree, you are not authorized to participate.

1. Approval or Rejection of Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject any affiliate application at our sole discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for rejection.

2. Affiliate Links and Coupon Codes

Affiliate links are automatically generated, and you may also create links for specific products or collections.

  • If a user clicks multiple affiliate links, the last click will be credited.
  • Affiliates may be assigned a custom coupon code (if applicable).
  • Commission is not doubled if both a link and coupon are used.
  • Only assigned coupon codes may be promoted.

Affiliates may promote Edifier through approved online and offline channels.

3. Commissions & Payment Terms

Commission Structure

  • Commission is earned on completed purchases referred through your affiliate link.
  • Commission is calculated on order value excluding taxes, shipping, and fees.

Payout Timeline

  • Commissions are processed 45 days after the end of the month in which the sale was generated.
  • This includes:
    • 30-day refund period
    • 15-day processing period

Example:
Sales from March → Refund window (April) → Paid mid-May

Refund Policy

  • Edifier offers a 30-day refund period.
  • Any refunded or canceled orders will result in voided commissions.

Minimum Payout & Fees

  • Minimum payout threshold: $100
  • If earnings ≥ $100:
    • Edifier covers payout processing fees
  • If earnings < $100:
    • Affiliate may still withdraw, but fees are covered by the affiliate

Payment Requirements

  • Affiliates must ensure accurate payment details are added to their dashboard.
  • Payments are only issued for approved, valid transactions.
  • Any fraudulent, refunded, or disputed transactions will not be paid.

4. Marketing Tools

We may provide banners, logos, and promotional assets via the affiliate dashboard.

Affiliates are encouraged to use these materials to improve performance.

5. Network (If Enabled)

Affiliates may refer other affiliates and earn network commissions depending on program settings.

6. Cookie Policy

  • Tracking is based on cookies.
  • Cookie duration is defined at signup.
  • If cookies are blocked or cleared, tracking may not occur.
  • All purchases within the cookie window will be attributed to the affiliate.

7. PPC & Trademark Bidding Policy (Strictly Prohibited)

Affiliates may NOT:

  • Bid on Edifier trademark terms, including:
    • “Edifier”
    • “Edifier speakers”
    • “Edifier headphones”
    • Any misspellings or variations
  • Engage in TM+ bidding (e.g., “Edifier discount”, “Edifier coupon”)
  • Use direct linking from paid ads to our website
  • Use Edifier brand terms in ad copy, display URLs, or landing pages

Violation of these terms may result in:

  • Commission reversal
  • Removal from the affiliate program

8. Removal from the Program

Affiliates may request removal at any time by contacting:
media@edifier.ca

We also reserve the right to remove affiliates at our discretion.

9. General Conditions

  • All affiliate activity must comply with applicable laws and platform guidelines.
  • We reserve the right to update these terms at any time.

Final Note

We’re glad to have you as part of the Edifier Affiliate Program and look forward to growing together.

If you have any questions, please contact:
media@edifier.ca
